title: tau init --json output
description: Schema for the single JSON object `tau init [--json]` prints on stdout after writing (or overwriting with --force) the starter config. --stdout prints the JSONC scaffold itself instead of this object and is mutually exclusive with --json. New keys may be added (additive); existing keys keep their names and types.

config_path.description: Absolute path of the config file that was written, e.g. ~/.config/tau/config.json.

provider.description: Provider the scaffold was seeded for — an explicit --provider, else the first provider with a detected env key, else the default.

created.description: true when the run wrote a config file (always true on a successful write-path run).

overwritten.description: true when an existing config file was replaced via --force.

detected_env_keys.description: Names of the provider API-key environment variables found set on this machine (TAU_API_KEY included when the fallback is set). Values, never key material — only variable names.
